1882.legend_note: swatch interiors, 8 px inset, read by eye 2026-10-01: ink = service-local black hatch, paper = non affectees (blank)

layer_rule: layer = water (default) or road. Water windows: trace class water. Road windows: trace every NON-road face as class block, extended past the window edge; road is the rest. ignore works in both.
split_rule: calibrate = may be used to fit the appearance model and tune the method. heldout = never looked at by a method or threshold, scored once. seen = already used in a 2026-10-01 diagnostic, so it is NOT clean held-out even if listed there.
